speaker: Christian C. Chigbundu
title: Spiritual Immunity
summary: Elder Chigbundu teaches that just as the body has immunity against disease, we can build spiritual immunity that gives us strength and courage in troubled times. He names four small and simple things that build it, scripture study, prayer, the sacrament, and covenants, and tells of a homesick missionary helped by daily Book of Mormon study and a sister with cancer in Côte d’Ivoire who feels the Savior’s love through daily prayer. He asks listeners to search the scriptures diligently and to always remember these four things, calling them the armor of God against the devil.
